items.headline: Bam McReynolds rushes for 2 TDs, including go-ahead 48-yarder as UAB edges Navy 24-20
items.description: — Bam McReynolds followed a Navy turnover in the fourth quarter with a 48-yard touchdown run and UAB rallied to beat the Midshipman 24-20 on Friday night in the Blazers' American Conference opener.
